state:
Goal `core-request-1-2`: `Core\Request::body`, `bytes`, `bodyStream`, `clientIp` and `cookie` have
all their feature proofs. `bun nv proofs --verify --only` over those five says nothing owed.
A proof program answers a request through the `<name>.nvsr` beside it (`docs/examples/README.md` §
*A request for the program*). The peer's address is the `--CLIENT_IP--` section, and the effective
scheme is `--SCHEME--` (`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs`'s module doc). A file with neither
describes a request with no address, over plain HTTP. A new bench is measured with `bun nv proofs
--record-perf --only <members>`, and only the members without a current figure are measured. `bun nv
verify` regenerates `docs/novis.md` from the rewritten cards. Six members of `Core\Request (1/2)` still owe their proofs, in the order the check lists them.
